db_evidence.notes: The memory DB contains a genuine internal contradiction: event_steps 00001871/00016213/00027209/00030573 (all timestamped 77520-77610) describe a chest that 'yields'/'receives item rewards' including 藕丝步云履 among 4 items, while event_steps:00027214 (79440-79530) and topic_facts:00014065 (79500s) describe a separate, later cutscene where 藕丝步云履 is explicitly 'acquired (72 defense, 30 agility)' and shown as an equipped item popup. clip_qa in rollout 3 visually confirmed the true acquisition happens at ~79507s, well after all 8 clue intervals (which end at 79036), consistent with the reference answer of 8. Beyond the acquisition-time ambiguity, the 8 individual somersault-cloud uses are NOT reliably tagged with the term 筋斗云 in the episodes/event_steps text for 5 of the 8 clue windows (77804-77873, 77955-78006, 78912-78888, 79016-79036, plus ambiguous phrasing at 78551-78575) -- they are captioned inconsistently as 'flying mount', 'mechanical glider', 'aerial leap', 'spectral wake trail', 'blue motion trail', and even once mislabeled as footage from a different game (Zelda: Breath of the Wild) -- so exhaustive counting requires clip_qa across the full range rather than text/semantic search alone.

root_causes: A misleading/contradictory DB record (early chest-loot listing that names 藕丝步云履 among several dropped items at 77580-77610) caused 4 of 5 rollouts to anchor the acquisition event far too early, truncating their counting window to a single cloud-dash and yielding a wildly wrong count of 1.

The one rollout (3) that correctly resolved the acquisition-time ambiguity via clip_qa still under-covered the full 77550-79036 window, using clip_qa on only 2 of the ~4-5 needed sub-windows and never checking the 78600-79440 gap, so it missed 4 of 8 true occurrences.

Textual/semantic evidence for individual somersault-cloud uses is inconsistently captioned across episodes/event_steps (varying terms, one outright wrong-game caption), making pure SQL/semantic-search counting unreliable for this ability without systematic visual verification of every clue window.

No rollout ran clip_qa across the entire 77550-79036 span systematically; all treated either the acquisition-time question or the counting question as resolved after partial evidence rather than exhaustively tiling the interval.
what_worked: Rollout 3's use of semantic_search over topic_facts + event_steps successfully surfaced the correct, stat-bearing acquisition cutscene (79440-79530) and clip_qa correctly pinned it to ~79507s, avoiding the DB's misleading early chest-loot text that fooled the other four rollouts.
Rollout 3's clip_qa calls, when issued, correctly and precisely identified activation timestamps (77551, 77659, 78501, 78554) matching 4 of the 8 reference clue intervals almost exactly.
transferable_lessons: When two DB records disagree about when an item was 'obtained' (a chest-loot list vs. a stat-popup cutscene), treat the more specific/definitive record (item stats, 'already equipped' popup) as ground truth and use clip_qa to visually confirm before anchoring a counting window on it.

For counting questions over a long, multi-hour-spanning clue range, tile clip_qa calls across the ENTIRE candidate window in fixed-size chunks (e.g. every event_chain segment from the first candidate use to the confirmed acquisition time) rather than stopping after finding a plausible acquisition point or after 1-2 spot-checks.

Do not rely solely on episodes/event_steps text to count occurrences of a specific named ability; captions for the same ability can vary across clips (different phrasings, or even a wrong-game caption), so visual confirmation via clip_qa is necessary for exhaustive counting.

Before finalizing a count, cross-check that the number of confirmed occurrences plausibly covers the entire time span between the first candidate activation and the confirmed acquisition event; a large unexamined gap (here ~840s, from 78600 to 79440) is a signal that more clip_qa coverage is needed.
open_questions: Whether the early chest-loot description listing 藕丝步云履 (event_steps:00001871) is an upstream captioning/annotation error, or reflects a genuine early item preview/pickup that the game later re-displays with stats at 79440-79530 -- this ambiguity in the source DB is itself worth flagging to whoever built the memory database.

Whether a clip_qa sweep across the full 78600-79440 gap would have found exactly the 2 remaining clue-interval uses (78912-78888, 79016-79036) needed to reach the reference count of 8, or additional/fewer uses -- not verified directly against video frames in this diagnosis.
